capabilities: Synchronize vault files bidirectionally with Mail.ru Cloud via WebDAV
Encrypt notes and attachments client-side with AES-256-GCM before upload
Transfer plugin settings between devices via encrypted link
Pause sync when mass deletions exceed a threshold
Resolve sync conflicts with configurable strategies and scheduled intervals
extras: The README warns users to back up their vault before first sync and stresses that a dedicated Mail.ru application password (not the account password) is required. Developed with 'Superintelligence technologies (SI pair programming)' per the credits. Interface is localized in English and Russian.
intentEvidence: built upon the open-source Yandex Disk Sync plugin by Nikolay Eltsov, adapted for Mail.ru Cloud WebDAV protocol
motivation: The README credits the Yandex Disk Sync plugin's sync engine, three-way merge logic, and queue implementation as the basis for this Mail.ru adaptation.
problem: Obsidian's paid Sync service doesn't cover Mail.ru Cloud, so users of that service lack a way to sync their vault with it, let alone with client-side encryption.

relations.evidence: This project is built upon the open-source Yandex Disk Sync plugin by Nikolay Eltsov
relations.plugin: Yandex Disk Sync by Nikolay Eltsov

relations.evidence: Connects directly to official Mail.ru Cloud servers without third-party proxies

requires.name: Mail.ru account with a WebDAV application password

summary: Vault sync plugin that synchronizes notes and attachments with Mail.ru Cloud over WebDAV, with AES-256-GCM end-to-end encryption.
